data.name: Bach Chorales
data.abstract: Time-series data based on chorales; challenge is to learn generative grammar; data in Lisp

additional_info.summary: Sequential (time-series) domain.  Single-line melodies of 100 Bach chorales (originally 4 voices).  The melody line can be studied independently of other voices.  The grand challenge is to learn a generative grammar for stylistically valid chorales (see references and discussion in "Multiple Viewpoint Systems for Music Prediction").
